place: Lamai, Maret, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Modern-Luxury Three-Bedroom Pool Villas near Lamai Village
blurb: An exclusive enclave of just ten modern-luxury villas moments from Lamai Village, 500 metres from the beach and walkable to shops, restaurants and island amenities. Three-bedroom homes with a private pool, indoor and outdoor kitchens, a second-floor terrace and landscaped tropical gardens. Off-plan and freehold, from ฿14,500,000 with a projected 11.9% net ROI.
detail:
A small, exclusive enclave of just ten residences set close to the heart of Lamai Village on Koh Samui's south-east coast — 500 metres from Lamai Beach and within walking distance of shops, restaurants and lifestyle amenities. It is a rare balance of genuine convenience and refined, private island living.

Each three-bedroom villa is designed in a modern-luxury idiom, with spacious interiors and generous outdoor spaces for relaxing and entertaining. A private swimming pool anchors the plot; an elegant indoor kitchen pairs with a covered outdoor BBQ kitchen and dining area; and a second-floor terrace opens the upper level to the tropical surroundings. Interiors run to 345 m² on plots of 400–500 m², with three bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms.

The specification is thorough: a full-house boiler system, a private car park, automated gate and walls, and high-quality construction throughout. The community itself is landscaped with tropical gardens and served by underground electricity, setting a new standard for comfort in this part of Samui. A furniture package is available at ฿1,300,000.

Offered freehold or leasehold. Freehold ownership is available to Thai nationals or through a Thai company; the leasehold route carries no annual lease fee, with extension possible for only the administrative and legal costs, and is secured with superficies rights. Sold off-plan, with a projected net ROI of around 11.9%. Payment schedule, floor plans and specification available on request.
